assets.name: steel-guardian
assets.prompt:
Create a production-ready transparent PNG animation sprite sheet for a 2D side-scrolling action game. Use ONLY the specified single boss from the attached reference; preserve its identity, materials, colors and premium 2.5D illustrated render. Canvas square 2048x2048, EXACTLY 4 columns x 4 rows, 16 equal isolated cells, no labels, no grid lines, transparent background, no ground shadows. All characters face LEFT in consistent three-quarter side view. Identical character model and scale across cells. Feet baseline at 90% of EACH cell for standing poses; character body centered at x=55% of each cell; leave ample margin so every weapon stays entirely inside its cell. Never draw multiple characters in a cell. Preserve round black stickman helmet and narrow black articulated limbs beneath armor. Clearly BEND elbows and knees and change torso posture; do not just translate or rotate the idle figure. Read left-to-right then top-to-bottom: row1: (0) relaxed battle idle, (1) running long left-leg forward/right-leg back with counter-swing arms, (2) running passing step knees bent opposite arm swing, (3) running right-leg forward/left-leg back. Row2: (4) low crouching brace attack anticipation, (5) big winding-up weapon or fist held high behind head with torso twist, (6) powerful fully extended forward horizontal strike toward left, (7) low forward leaning follow-through with weapon at lower left. Row3: (8) deep crouch compressing for jump, (9) airborne with knees tucked and weapon overhead, (10) descending with legs extending and weapon thrust downward, (11) heavy landing crouch one knee bent and hand or weapon touching ground. Row4: (12) upright casting preparation one hand extended and the other drawn back, (13) spell release with BOTH arms stretched forward left, (14) visibly staggered hit reaction leaning back with arms thrown apart, (15) recovery rising from crouch back toward idle. No external explosions, no detached projectiles, effects confined to equipment. Each pose's silhouette must look meaningfully different, animation quality is paramount. Reference boss to animate: TOP LEFT steel guardian: black round helmet, red visor, massive graphite and gold industrial armor, orange reactor, giant hammer.
Refine the attached steel guardian animation sheet. Correct any overlap or stray weapon fragments between cells. CRITICAL EMPTY MARGINS: every complete character INCLUDING the most extended hammer must fit in the central 72 percent of its cell, with at least 14 percent empty padding on every edge. Character may be smaller than reference to ensure separation. Every cell is independent; no pose or glow may cross a cell boundary. Exact equal 4x4 grid and consistent character scale. Maintain the exact pose sequence listed above, but NEVER place a hammer from a neighbor cell inside another cell. Entire airborne pose including raised hammer entirely inside its own cell. Keep beautiful sculpted steel and gold armor.
